name: io.github.chittychat-studio/replore
title: Replore
description: Find open-source GitHub repos that fit your project, ranked by relevance, stars and license.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional GitHub token: raises GitHub's search rate limit. Sent only to api.github.com, never printed.

environmentVariables.name: REPLORE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Replore Pro key: turns on meaning ranking (semantic). Sent only to Replore's own server.
